title: shared shapes
description: The shapes mankit gives every Go app, written once and referenced with $ref, so each app's answers describe them in one place. The document itself takes one of each, so its sample shows them.

featureState.description: One feature an app can switch, and whether it is on on this machine: mankit's features.State, which every Go app answers its switches with.

id.description: The feature's id, which the app's enable feature and disable feature take.

covers.description: What the feature covers, in words for people, so a reader says what switching it off closes.

needs.description: The values the feature needs to run, so switching it on can name each one missing; absent when it needs none.

startsOff.description: True for a feature that is off until switched on, so a reader says why it is off on a new machine; absent when it starts on.

on.description: True when nothing closes the feature, so its routes and controls are open.

by.description: What closed it; absent while it is on. An open word, so a later closer (public mode, a license) needs no new contract, and a reader shows the words for any other. Known words: switch: the owner switched it off; default: it starts off and nobody switched it on.

missing.description: The values the feature needs that are not set, so a feature that is on but cannot run says why; absent when none is missing.

featureValue.description: One value a feature needs, such as an environment variable or a settings row: mankit's features.Value.

name.description: The value's name, as it is set.

purpose.description: What the feature needs it for, in words for people.
